items.q: What are you actually buying with a ¥138 豆浆油条?
items.a: **The 47th floor.** Lobby Rolls / Maybach, a Michelin chef on breakfast, a terrace. Street breakfast he cites is ¥20–30 — about **10×**. The soy milk is just stronger beans.

items.q: What did breakfast cost after the free noodles?
items.a: Paid three: 小笼包, 豆浆油条, 牛肉粥 = **¥458**. Kitchen comps a 红烧牛肉面. He says the view would get old.

items.q: How did the tea book work?
items.a: No prices on the pick page. He points at 1980s 乌龙 → **¥1,580**. Same list has **¥12,800**. That is a **hidden-price menu**, not a tea ceremony.
**Ten jin of greens, leaves discarded**, hearts only. '有舍才有得.' Two meats + one veg + tea + service = **¥3,463.85**. He packs the leftover tea.

items.q: Why can a ¥399 apple still lose the day?
items.a: Lychee / rose cultivars, gift boxes ¥2.7k–¥3.6k, shop claims ¥400–500k/month **and still losing money**. Host is from Yantai. Juice is a short pour. **谁说值我揍谁.**

items.q: What is the real product of an unlimited-budget day?
items.a: **The clip.** 50k likes unlocks a Michelin three-meal follow-up. Taste can fail the receipt. The view and the hidden tea are the usable lessons.
